pr_title: GameEngine: rewrite animation motion candidate resolution
pr_body:
## Summary

- defines Animation Set candidates as model-bound clips such as `a / x`, `a / y`, plus one explicit `a / Humanoid` portable candidate
- resolves every model-bound candidate automatically as Native -> Retarget -> Humanoid -> Failed and exposes the computed route for the selected target
- makes the logical clip's Humanoid variant import/reimport-owned, never lazily created by Animation Set or Scene resolution
- adds stable Humanoid source-model provenance for VMD and other motion-only sources so one target-independent Humanoid candidate can be generated deterministically
- proposes Animation Set schema v3 to remove the obsolete Auto/Native policy distinction

## Scope

Design and documentation only. No runtime, Editor, importer, or serialization implementation is included.
